title: Tau-induced atrophy drives functional connectivity disruption in Alzheimer's disease
summary: Alzheimer's disease involves progressive tau accumulation and spread, leading to regional brain atrophy and disruption of large-scale functional networks. While tau propagation and tissue degeneration have been widely modeled, how atrophy dynamics translate into functional connectivity (FC) degradation remains unclear. Here, we develop a multiphysics framework integrating anisotropic tau reaction-diffusion, finite-deformation biomechanics, and network modeling to link tau-driven atrophy with FC changes.
